note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk in the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh, lowercase usfm/<book>.usfm; re-verified for this job 2026-10-09: jhn/mat/rom/heb return 200, deu/job/psa 404). The mirror carries no Old Testament, and its Matthew 4 collapses verses 14-17 into one line that drops the Isaiah quotation, so Matthew 4:16 comes from the corpus. OT quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

Every `mined` row was re-measured against the finished text: the quoted Amharic is an exact substring both of this chapter's block and of the cited Bible verse or corpus file. Partial quotations carry a/b. Re-personed allusions are self_rendered.

The English epigraphs are simplified child paraphrases ("— from Psalm 27"); following samuel-ajayi-crowther-a-life-children.am, each quotes the 1962 wording for the part the English means, with … for words left out, and cites `— ከ<Book> <chapter>`. Isaiah 1:17 and Malachi 3:10 have no shipped Amharic rendering and are self_rendered. Two quotations inside the story are allusions in Ramabai's own voice and are self_rendered: «ወዴት እንደምሄድ ሳላውቅ እንደ አብርሃም» (Hebrews 11:8, re-personed) and God's word to her «የዱሮውን ዘመን አስቢ» (Deuteronomy 32:7a, feminine imperative; the English gives no citation). Job 1:21b in chapter 12 is verbatim from the sermon blessed-adversity.am.json. Chapter 7's «የሕይወት ውኃ» is the 1962 phrase of John 4:10 (too short to count as a quotation).

Conventions matched to the plan prose for family-devotions-brave-and-faithful (data/plan_translations/am.json, job #5751): title «ፓንዲታ ራማባይ (ለልጆች)»; ፓንዲታ ራማባይ, ሕንድ, መበለቶች as listed there; every chapter carries its three study_questions, as the plan card promises. Place names follow the am corpus (ፑኔ, ካልካታ, ካሽሚር, ሙክቲ «መዳን», ማራቲ, ጆርጅ ሙለር).
